verdict.line: You lose if you let him poke you to half HP before level 6; you win if you force stand-still trades and shove him off turret plates.

brief.thesis: Teemo has no hard CC and no escape besides Move Quick's passive speed, so Sion's all-in is never blocked by anything except range and Blind. The whole lane is Sion closing a 680-range gap while eating free Toxic Shot poke, which matches the close 46.3% win rate over 164 games despite Sion otherwise sitting at 49.6% overall in this lane.

theirWindow.when: you're walking up to minions or towers
theirWindow.what: Teemo auto-attacks apply Toxic Shot for free poke damage over time with zero cooldown, so every CS attempt or trade approach costs you a stacking DOT tick before you even reach him.

yourWindow.when: W shield is up and he's in auto range
yourWindow.what: Pop W (Death's Caress) before closing the gap so the absorb shield eats his first 1-2 Toxic Shot hits, then land Q (Cryptic Gaze) for the stun the instant you're in his 550 range — he has nothing to punish the stun with.

powerCurve.note: Toxic Shot pokes free, Q has no stun
Q (Cryptic Gaze) stun lets you punish approaches
Core items let you tank through Blinding Dart
Mushrooms control zones, you still split

start.why: The flat damage reduction on the first attack from each unit directly cuts into Teemo's low-damage, high-frequency Toxic Shot poke, which is the only thing he has before level 6.

boots.why: The magic resist and tenacity shortens how long Blinding Dart's blind lingers and softens every poison tick from Toxic Shot and Noxious Trap.

core.why: Builds straight into the magic resist and health you need against a pure magic-damage poke champion, while keeping your wave-clear strong.
More magic resist plus the damage-reduction proc turns his poison ticks into near-nothing once you're stacked up.
The resistance-stacking passive scales directly against a champion whose entire kit is small, repeated magic ticks.

situational.when: he builds any attack speed items to try to out-poke you with autos
you're ahead and need to clear mushroom fields and push waves faster

runes.keystoneWhy: Grasp heals you back from every Toxic Shot tick you eat while farming, directly countering the chip damage that defines this matchup pre-6.

summoners.why: Teleport is run in 85.6% of games here because Teemo has no kill pressure to punish your base-and-return, and you want to answer his mushroom-controlled side lanes without losing tempo.

playing.title: Shield before you approach
playing.detail: Pop W (Death's Caress) a step before walking into his auto range so the absorb shield tanks the first Toxic Shot hits instead of your health bar.

playing.title: Save Q for the stun window
playing.detail: Q (Cryptic Gaze) has an 8-12s cooldown depending on rank and only 550 range, so hold it until you're actually in cast range rather than throwing it on cooldown for poke.

playing.title: Trade on cooldowns, not on sight
playing.detail: His E (Toxic Shot) has zero cooldown but his Q (Blinding Dart) is 8s — track when he's used Blinding Dart and all-in in that window since he can't blind your stun or auto-lock.

playing.title: Ult for sustain, not burst
playing.detail: R (Cannibalism) has a 90s cooldown and heals off every attack, so use it in extended skirmishes or dives, not as a reactive panic button in a short poke trade.

playing.title: Clear mushrooms before pathing
playing.detail: Noxious Trap has only a 1s cooldown so he can carpet jungle entrances; walk wide or clear visible mushrooms before committing to a gank path or back line.

playing.title: Respect Move Quick resets
playing.detail: W (Move Quick) gives him passive speed that resets if he's hit by you or a turret, so land your first stick (auto or Q) early in the chase or he'll kite forever.

playing.title: Push waves into his tower
playing.detail: He has no wave-clear tool beyond autos, so use E (Enrage) trades on minions to shove and force him to either lose CS or take poke from your tower.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the matchup mechanics and trade-pattern reasoning are my own analysis of the kits.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being punished before reaching level 3 by keeping your distance. Use your skills off cooldown to poke and gain control over lane.
